title: Choice questions
unsaved: Unsaved configuration changes will be discarded.
config_locked: A team has started. The bank, question counts and scores are locked.
config_help: Each team shares a paper. Questions are randomly selected by type once, when the team starts. Configuration locks after the first start. Multiple choice earns points only for an exact match; no partial credit.
insufficient: Not enough questions in the bank. Add questions or reduce the counts.
import_help: Import UTF-8 JSON or CSV. In CSV, separate options with | and use letters such as A,C for answers. JSON answers are zero-based indices. Review the import, then save the configuration to apply it.
empty_bank: Add or import questions to get started.
answers_help: Use letters such as A or A,C. Single choice requires one correct answer; multiple choice requires at least two.
bank_limit: The bank supports at most 5,000 questions.
imported: Imported {{count}} questions. Review and save the configuration.
discard_pending: Your unsaved answer will be discarded and the last saved paper restored.
player_help: Selections are saved automatically. Wait for “Saved” before leaving; return any time to resume. Complete every question before submitting. Submission locks the paper for the entire team.
paper_info: {{single}} single-choice questions ({{singleScore}} points each), {{multiple}} multiple-choice questions ({{multipleScore}} points each). Multiple choice requires an exact match.
final_result: Submitted at {{time}}. Score: {{score}} / {{total}}. The paper is locked.
submit_help: Complete and save every question before submitting. Submitted papers cannot be edited.
submit_warning: After submission, nobody on your team can change any answer. Make sure every question is complete.
